name: Idle auto-compact
description: Automatically compacts a conversation when a session has been idle for a while and its context window is getting full. Summarises the conversation and continues in a fresh session seeded with the hand-off summary (CLI /compact semantics).

properties.title: Idle minutes
properties.description: Compact a session only after it has been idle for at least this many minutes.

properties.title: Context threshold (%)
properties.description: Compact when the context window is at least this % full (of the auto-compact threshold when known, otherwise of maxTokens).

properties.title: Min history messages
properties.description: Skip sessions with fewer than this many history messages — avoids compacting thin conversations.
